meta.name: add-gmail-tool
meta.description: Add Gmail as an MCP tool (read, search, send, label, draft) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. The agent gets Gmail tools in every enabled group; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time so no raw credentials are ever in the container or on disk in usable form.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 MCP 工具读取、搜索、发送和管理 Gmail 邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 agent 中通过 MCP 操作 Gmail 邮箱。
copy.tagline_en: Read, search, send, and manage Gmail emails via MCP tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Gmail from an agent via MCP.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能读取、搜索、发送、草稿和标记 Gmail 邮件，并管理标签和过滤器。
howto.when: 当你在已启用该技能的对话中要求 Claude 操作 Gmail（如“列出我的标签”）时触发。

say.text: 搜索我收件箱里上个月的发票。
say.note: Claude 会调用搜索工具查找邮件。

say.text: 给张三发一封邮件，主题是会议提醒。
列出我所有的 Gmail 标签。
say.note: Claude 会调用列出标签工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read, search, send, draft, and label Gmail emails, and manage labels and filters.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to perform Gmail operations (e.g., "list my labels") in a conversation where the skill is enabled.

say_en.text: Search my inbox for invoices from last month.
say_en.note: Claude will use the search tool.

say_en.text: Send an email to John about the meeting reminder.
say_en.note: Claude will use the send tool.
Claude will use the list labels tool.
